memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Follow-up for low mood and fatigue.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: She reports persistent low mood, reduced energy, and poor concentration over the past 2 months. Denies suicidal thoughts.
EXAMINATION: BP 122/78 mmHg, weight 68 kg, height 1.58 m, BMI 27.2 (obese). General appearance calm, no psychomotor retardation.
IMPRESSION: Depression, moderate. Current sertraline 50 mg OD partially effective. Advise lifestyle, diet, exercise. Order fasting lipid profile and fasting blood sugar as annual screen.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue sertraline 50 mg OD, repeat in 6 weeks. Return if worsening mood, suicidal ideas, chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, or bloody stools.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Sertraline 50 mg orally once daily for 28 days.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Review of depression treatment.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Mood still low, PHQ-9 score 14. Reports mild insomnia.
EXAMINATION: BP 124/80 mmHg, weight 67.5 kg, BMI 27.0 (obese).
IMPRESSION: Partial response to sertraline. Increase dose to improve symptoms. No thyroid abnormalities suspected; will check TSH.
ARRANGEMENTS: Increase sertraline to 100 mg OD. Repeat PHQ-9 in 4 weeks. Return if worsening depression, agitation, chest pain, fever >39°C, or suicidal thoughts.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Sertraline 100 mg orally once daily for 28 days.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Autumn review; flu vaccine offered.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Mood improved, PHQ-9 8. Reports better sleep but occasional daytime fatigue.
EXAMINATION: BP 120/76 mmHg, weight 67 kg, BMI 26.8 (overweight).
IMPRESSION: Depression, mild to moderate. Sertraline 100 mg OD helpful. Add mirtazapine 15 mg HS for sleep aid. Check vitamin B12 and TSH.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue sertraline 100 mg OD, start mirtazapine 15 mg HS at night. Offer influenza vaccine; patient accepts today. Return if new rash, swelling, fever >39°C, worsening mood, or suicidal ideas.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Mirtazapine 15 mg orally at bedtime for 30 days.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Fasting lipid profile: Cholesterol 5.2 mmol/L (<5.2 normal), Triglycerides 1.8 mmol/L (<1.7 borderline high), HDL 1.2 mmol/L (>1.0 normal), LDL 3.0 mmol/L (<2.6 high). Fasting blood sugar: 5.6 mmol/L (<6.1 normal).

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Winter follow‑up.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Reports daytime sedation and weight gain (~2 kg) since adding mirtazapine. PHQ-9 6.
EXAMINATION: BP 126/80 mmHg, weight 70 kg, BMI 28.0 (obese).
IMPRESSION: Depression improved but mirtazapine causing sedation and weight gain. Consider switching to escitalopram. Check TSH and vitamin B12.
ARRANGEMENTS: Stop mirtazapine, start escitalopram 10 mg OD. Repeat PHQ-9 in 4 weeks. Return if worsening depression, suicidal thoughts, chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, or unusual bleeding.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Escitalopram 10 mg orally once daily for 28 days. Discontinue mirtazapine.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Spring check‑up.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Mood stable, PHQ-9 5. No sedation. Reports mild anxiety.
EXAMINATION: BP 124/78 mmHg, weight 69.5 kg, BMI 27.8 (overweight).
IMPRESSION: Depression in remission on escitalopram 10 mg OD. Consider dose increase for anxiety. Vitamin B12 low at 180 pg/mL (reference 200‑900).
ARRANGEMENTS: Increase escitalopram to 20 mg OD. Start vitamin B12 1000 mcg OD. Repeat labs in 3 months. Return if worsening mood, anxiety, chest pain, fever >39°C, or suicidal ideas.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Escitalopram 20 mg orally once daily for 28 days. Vitamin B12 1000 mcg orally once daily.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Vitamin B12 340 pg/mL (200‑900 normal). TSH 2.1 mIU/L (0.4‑4.0 normal). PHQ-9 4.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Feeling much better, energy improved, sleeping well. Minor nausea with B12 supplement, taking with food helps.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Annual autumn review.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Mood good, PHQ-9 3. No side effects.
EXAMINATION: BP 122/76 mmHg, weight 69 kg, BMI 27.6 (overweight).
IMPRESSION: Depression well controlled on escitalopram 20 mg OD and vitamin B12. Lipids stable; fasting glucose normal.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue current meds. Offer influenza vaccine for this season; patient declines, states already vaccinated elsewhere. Return if worsening depression, suicidal thoughts, chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, or abnormal bleeding.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow‑up appointment booked for 2027-01-15 at 10:00 AM with Dr Priya Natarajan (D03).
